| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | When `false`, no request is made. |
| `include` | `"ACTIVE" \| "DELETED"` | `"ACTIVE"` | Which users to list. |
| `pageSize` | `number` | `1000` | Preferred page size. The server can return more or fewer. |
| `pageToken` | `string` | `undefined` | Token for the page to load. Omit for the first page. |

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `users` | `User[] \| undefined` | The users on this page. |
| `nextPageToken` | `string \| undefined` | Token for the next page. `undefined` on the last page. |
| `isLoading`, `error`, `refetch` | | As for `useCurrentFoundryUser`. |

Each page replaces the previous one. To show every page loaded so far, keep the users you have received in state.

## List markings

`useMarkings` lists the markings the user can see, and `useMarkingCategories` lists the categories they belong to. Join them on `marking.categoryId`:

```tsx title="src/MarkingList.tsx"
import { useMarkingCategories, useMarkings } from "@osdk/react/platform-apis";

export function MarkingList() {
  const { markings, error: markingsError } = useMarkings({ includeDeleted: false });
  const { categories, error: categoriesError } = useMarkingCategories({
    includeDeleted: false,
  });

  const categoryName = new Map(categories?.map((c) => [c.id, c.name] as const));

  return (
    <div>
      {(markingsError ?? categoriesError) && <p role="alert">Could not load markings.</p>}
      <ul>
        {markings?.map((marking) => (
          <li key={marking.id}>
            {categoryName.get(marking.categoryId) ?? "Other"}: {marking.name}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}
```

| Hook | Option | Default | Returns |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `useMarkings` | `includeDeleted` | `true` | `markings`: `Marking[]`, each with `id`, `categoryId`, `name`, `description`, and `deleted`. |
| `useMarkingCategories` | `includeDeleted` | `true` | `categories`: `MarkingCategory[]`, each with `id`, `name`, `description`, `markings` (marking IDs), and `deleted`. |
| Both | `markingType` | All types | Only markings or categories of this type, such as `"CBAC"`. |

Both accept `enabled` and return `isLoading`, `error`, and `refetch`. Deleted entries are included unless you pass `includeDeleted: false`.

## Get a user's markings

`useUserViewMarkings` returns the IDs of the markings a user can view. Without `userId`, it uses the signed-in user:

```tsx title="src/useCanView.ts"
import { useUserViewMarkings } from "@osdk/react/platform-apis";

export function useCanView(requiredMarkingIds: string[]) {
  const { markingIds, isLoading, error } = useUserViewMarkings();
  const viewable = new Set(markingIds);

  return {
    canView: markingIds != null && requiredMarkingIds.every((id) => viewable.has(id)),
    isLoading,
    error,
  };
}
```

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `userId` | `string` | Signed-in user | The user to look up. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | When `false`, no request is made. |

The result has `markingIds` (`string[] | undefined`), `isLoading`, `error`, and `refetch`.

## Show a classification banner

For classification-based access control (CBAC), `useCbacBanner` returns the banner text and colors for a set of marking IDs:

```tsx title="src/ClassificationBanner.tsx"
import { useCbacBanner } from "@osdk/react/platform-apis";

export function ClassificationBanner({ markingIds }: { markingIds: string[] }) {
  const { banner, error } = useCbacBanner({ markingIds });

  if (error != null || banner == null) {
    return null;
  }
  const [first, ...rest] = banner.backgroundColors;
  const background =
    rest.length > 0 ? `linear-gradient(90deg, ${banner.backgroundColors.join(", ")})` : first;

  return (
    <div role="banner" style={{ background, color: banner.textColor, textAlign: "center" }}>
      {banner.classificationString}
    </div>
  );
}
```

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `banner.classificationString` | `string` | The banner text. |
| `banner.textColor` | `string` | Text color. |
| `banner.backgroundColors` | `string[]` | One or more background colors. |
| `banner.markingIds` | `string[]` | The markings the banner represents. |

`useCbacMarkingRestrictions` checks a proposed set of marking IDs before you apply it, for example in a marking picker:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `restrictions.isValid` | `boolean` | Whether the markings form a valid classification: none are disallowed and every required constraint is met. |
| `restrictions.userSatisfiesMarkings` | `boolean` | Whether the signed-in user satisfies the markings. |
| `restrictions.impliedMarkings` | `string[]` | Markings that the selection implies. |
| `restrictions.disallowedMarkings` | `string[]` | Markings that are disallowed with the selection. |
| `restrictions.requiredMarkings` | `string[][]` | Required marking constraints, as groups of marking IDs. |

Both hooks take `{ markingIds, enabled? }`, return `isLoading`, `error`, and `refetch`, and make no request while `markingIds` is empty. They call preview CBAC endpoints, which must be available on your Foundry stack. For a ready-made picker, see the [CbacPicker component](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/components/cbac-picker.md).

## How these hooks load data

These hooks do not use the object cache that powers `useOsdkObjects` and the other ontology hooks:

- Each mounted hook makes its own request. Two components that call `useCurrentFoundryUser` make two requests. Call the hook once and pass the result down when that matters.
- A hook requests again when an option changes. `refetch` requests again on demand.
- While a request runs, the previous result is cleared and the data field is `undefined`.
- When a request fails, `isLoading` stays `true` next to `error`. Check `error` before `isLoading`, as the examples on this page do.

## Handle errors

All hooks return failures as an `Error`. When the failure comes from a Foundry API, it is a `PalantirApiError`, exported from `@osdk/client`. Narrow with `instanceof` to read its fields, all of which are optional:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `errorName` | `string` | Stable identifier, such as `UserNotFound`. Switch on this. |
| `errorCode` | `string` | Error category, such as `NOT_FOUND` or `PERMISSION_DENIED`. |
| `errorDescription` | `string` | Human-readable description. |
| `statusCode` | `number` | HTTP status. |
| `errorInstanceId` | `string` | Server-side ID for this occurrence. Include it in bug reports. |
| `parameters` | `object` | Extra context from the server, such as `{ userId }`. |

```tsx title="src/describePlatformError.ts"
import { PalantirApiError } from "@osdk/client";

export function describePlatformError(error: Error): string {
  if (!(error instanceof PalantirApiError)) {
    return error.message;
  }
  if (error.errorName === "UserNotFound") {
    return "We couldn't find that user.";
  }
  if (error.errorCode === "PERMISSION_DENIED") {
    return "You don't have permission to see this.";
  }
  return `${error.errorDescription ?? error.message} (error ID: ${error.errorInstanceId ?? "unknown"})`;
}
```

Use it with any hook on this page:

```tsx title="src/UserCard.tsx"
import { useFoundryUser } from "@osdk/react/platform-apis";
import { describePlatformError } from "./describePlatformError";

export function UserCard({ userId }: { userId: string }) {
  const { user, error } = useFoundryUser(userId);

  return (
    <article>
      {error && <p role="alert">{describePlatformError(error)}</p>}
      {user && <h2>{user.username}</h2>}
      {user?.email && <p>{user.email}</p>}
    </article>
  );
}
```

# Test your app

Source: https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/react/testing

> Unit test OSDK React components with Vitest and Testing Library, using @osdk/react/testing and the mocks in @osdk/unit-testing.

Related Palantir Foundry documentation:
- [Unit testing OSDK code](https://www.palantir.com/docs/foundry/ontology-sdk/typescript-osdk-testing)

{/* cspell:ignore jsdom msw MSW stubbable */}

Test components that use `@osdk/react` without a Foundry stack. Stub the hooks a component calls, give components that read the OSDK context a test provider, and use mock clients and objects from `@osdk/unit-testing` for code that calls the client directly.

## Choose an approach

| What the code under test uses | Approach | Tools |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ontology hooks: `useOsdkObjects`, `useOsdkObject`, `useOsdkAction`, `useOsdkFunction`, and the rest | Replace the hook with a stub that returns the state you want to test | `vi.mock`, `createMockOsdkObject` |
| `useOsdkClient`, `useObservableClient`, or the hooks in `@osdk/react/platform-apis` | Render inside `TestOsdkProvider` | `@osdk/react/testing`, `createMockClient`, MSW |
| The `Client` directly, in a helper or hook | Pass a mock client with stubbed responses | `createMockClient`, `createMockObjectSet` |

Stubbing the ontology hooks keeps tests fast and lets you set loading, error, and optimistic states directly. The mock client from `@osdk/unit-testing` cannot power `OsdkProvider` or the ontology hooks, because they need the observable client that `OsdkProvider` builds from a real client.

## Set up

Install Vitest, a DOM environment, Testing Library, and the OSDK test helpers. `@osdk/unit-testing` has `@osdk/functions` as a peer dependency, and MSW is only needed for the platform API example:

```npm
npm install --save-dev vitest jsdom @testing-library/react @osdk/unit-testing @osdk/functions msw
```

Run tests in a DOM environment:

```ts title="vitest.config.ts"
import react from "@vitejs/plugin-react";
import { defineConfig } from "vitest/config";

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react()],
  test: {
    environment: "jsdom",
  },
});
```

`TestOsdkProvider` and `fakeObservableClient` ship in `@osdk/react` under `@osdk/react/testing`, so they need no extra install.

## Test a component that loads objects

This component lists employees with `useOsdkObjects`:

```tsx title="src/EmployeeList.tsx"
import { Employee } from "@my-app/sdk";
import { useOsdkObjects } from "@osdk/react";

export function EmployeeList() {
  const { data, isLoading, error } = useOsdkObjects(Employee, {
    orderBy: { fullName: "asc" },
  });

  return (
    <div>
      {isLoading && <p>Loading…</p>}
      {error && <p role="alert">{error.message}</p>}
      <ul>
        {data?.map((employee) => (
          <li key={employee.$primaryKey}>{employee.fullName}</li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}
```

Replace `useOsdkObjects` with a Vitest mock, keep the rest of `@osdk/react` real, and build objects with `createMockOsdkObject`:

```tsx title="src/EmployeeList.test.tsx"
import { Employee } from "@my-app/sdk";
import { useOsdkObjects } from "@osdk/react";
import { createMockOsdkObject } from "@osdk/unit-testing";
import { cleanup, render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { EmployeeList } from "./EmployeeList";

vi.mock("@osdk/react", async (importOriginal) => ({
  ...(await importOriginal<typeof import("@osdk/react")>()),
  useOsdkObjects: vi.fn(),
}));

type ListResult = ReturnType<typeof useOsdkObjects>;

function listResult(
  overrides: Omit<Partial<ListResult>, "data"> & { data?: unknown[] },
): ListResult {
  return {
    data: undefined,
    isLoading: false,
    error: undefined,
    isOptimistic: false,
    hasMore: false,
    fetchMore: undefined,
    objectSet: undefined,
    refetch: vi.fn(),
    ...overrides,
  } as ListResult;
}

describe("EmployeeList", () => {
  afterEach(cleanup);

  it("renders employees", () => {
    const ada = createMockOsdkObject(Employee, { employeeId: 1, fullName: "Ada Lovelace" });
    const alan = createMockOsdkObject(Employee, { employeeId: 2, fullName: "Alan Turing" });
    vi.mocked(useOsdkObjects).mockReturnValue(
      listResult({ data: [ada, alan] }),
    );

    render(<EmployeeList />);

    expect(screen.getAllByRole("listitem").map((li) => li.textContent)).toEqual([
      "Ada Lovelace",
      "Alan Turing",
    ]);
  });

  it("keeps rendering data while it reloads", () => {
    const ada = createMockOsdkObject(Employee, { employeeId: 1, fullName: "Ada Lovelace" });
    vi.mocked(useOsdkObjects).mockReturnValue(
      listResult({ data: [ada], isLoading: true }),
    );

    render(<EmployeeList />);

    expect(screen.getByText("Loading…")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText("Ada Lovelace")).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it("shows errors", () => {
    vi.mocked(useOsdkObjects).mockReturnValue(
      listResult({ error: new Error("Permission denied") }),
    );

    render(<EmployeeList />);

    expect(screen.getByRole("alert").textContent).toBe("Permission denied");
  });

  it("asks for employees sorted by name", () => {
    vi.mocked(useOsdkObjects).mockReturnValue(listResult({}));

    render(<EmployeeList />);

    expect(useOsdkObjects).toHaveBeenCalledWith(Employee, {
      orderBy: { fullName: "asc" },
    });
  });
});
```

`createMockOsdkObject(type, properties, options?)` returns an object instance with `$apiName`, `$objectType`, `$primaryKey`, `$rid`, `$clone`, and `$link`. The primary key property must be in `properties`. Pass `options.links` to stub linked objects, and `options.titlePropertyApiName` to set `$title`.

## Test a component that applies an action

Stub `useOsdkAction` and assert on the `applyAction` mock. This test drives the `PromoteButton` from [Apply actions](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/react/actions.md):

```tsx title="src/PromoteButton.test.tsx"
import { Employee } from "@my-app/sdk";
import { useOsdkAction } from "@osdk/react";
import { createMockOsdkObject } from "@osdk/unit-testing";
import { cleanup, fireEvent, render, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { PromoteButton } from "./PromoteButton";

vi.mock("@osdk/react", async (importOriginal) => ({
  ...(await importOriginal<typeof import("@osdk/react")>()),
  useOsdkAction: vi.fn(),
}));

const applyAction = vi.fn();

function actionResult(overrides: Partial<ReturnType<typeof useOsdkAction>> = {}) {
  return {
    applyAction,
    validateAction: vi.fn(),
    data: undefined,
    error: undefined,
    isPending: false,
    isValidating: false,
    validationResult: undefined,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

describe("PromoteButton", () => {
  const employee = createMockOsdkObject(Employee, { employeeId: 1, fullName: "Ada Lovelace" });

  beforeEach(() => {
    applyAction.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(undefined);
    vi.mocked(useOsdkAction).mockReturnValue(actionResult());
  });
  afterEach(cleanup);

  it("applies modifyEmployee with the new title", async () => {
    render(<PromoteButton employee={employee} jobTitle="Staff Engineer" />);

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Make Staff Engineer" }));

    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(applyAction).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ employee, jobTitle: "Staff Engineer" }),
    );
  });

  it("disables the button while the action runs", () => {
    vi.mocked(useOsdkAction).mockReturnValue(actionResult({ isPending: true }));

    render(<PromoteButton employee={employee} jobTitle="Staff Engineer" />);

    expect(screen.getByRole("button").hasAttribute("disabled")).toBe(true);
  });

  it("shows the failure", () => {
    vi.mocked(useOsdkAction).mockReturnValue(
      actionResult({ error: { unknown: new Error("Network error") } }),
    );

    render(<PromoteButton employee={employee} jobTitle="Staff Engineer" />);

    expect(screen.getByRole("alert").textContent).toContain("Could not update");
  });
});
```

The hook's state does not change by itself when the mock is called, so set `isPending`, `error`, or `validationResult` in each test rather than expecting `applyAction` to update them. To simulate a rejection, use `applyAction.mockRejectedValue(new Error("..."))`.

## Provide the OSDK context

`TestOsdkProvider` from `@osdk/react/testing` puts a `client` and an `observableClient` of your choice into context, without the devtools and user-agent setup of `OsdkProvider`. Use it when the code under test calls `useOsdkClient`, `useObservableClient`, or a platform API hook.

| Export | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `TestOsdkProvider` | Provider with `client` and `observableClient` props, both required. Use it only in tests. |
| `fakeObservableClient` | An `ObservableClient` whose every method throws. Pass it when the code under test never uses the observable client, so an unexpected call fails loudly. |

Platform API hooks call Foundry over HTTP with the context's `client`. A client from `createMockClient` sends those requests to `https://mock.invalid/`, so intercept them with MSW. This test renders the `CurrentUserBadge` from [Users and markings](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/react/platform-apis.md):

```tsx title="src/CurrentUserBadge.test.tsx"
import { fakeObservableClient, TestOsdkProvider } from "@osdk/react/testing";
import { createMockClient } from "@osdk/unit-testing";
import { cleanup, render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { http, HttpResponse } from "msw";
import { setupServer } from "msw/node";
import { afterAll, afterEach, beforeAll, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { CurrentUserBadge } from "./CurrentUserBadge";

const server = setupServer();

beforeAll(() => server.listen({ onUnhandledRequest: "error" }));
afterEach(() => {
  server.resetHandlers();
  cleanup();
});
afterAll(() => server.close());

it("greets the signed-in user", async () => {
  server.use(
    http.get("https://mock.invalid/api/v2/admin/users/getCurrent", () =>
      HttpResponse.json({
        id: "user-1",
        username: "ada",
        givenName: "Ada",
        realm: "default",
        status: "ACTIVE",
        attributes: {},
      }),
    ),
  );

  render(
    <TestOsdkProvider client={createMockClient()} observableClient={fakeObservableClient}>
      <CurrentUserBadge />
    </TestOsdkProvider>,
  );

  expect(await screen.findByText("Signed in as Ada")).toBeTruthy();
});
```

## Test code that calls the client

For a helper or hook that calls the `Client` itself, pass a client from `createMockClient` and register the responses it should get. Stubs match on the exact chain of calls, including arguments:

```ts title="src/loadDepartmentRoster.ts"
import { Employee } from "@my-app/sdk";
import type { Client } from "@osdk/client";

export async function loadDepartmentRoster(client: Client, department: string) {
  const page = await client(Employee)
    .where({ department: { $eq: department } })
    .fetchPage();
  return page.data.map((employee) => employee.fullName ?? "Unknown");
}
```

```ts title="src/loadDepartmentRoster.test.ts"
import { Employee, getEmployeeMetrics } from "@my-app/sdk";
import { createMockClient, createMockOsdkObject } from "@osdk/unit-testing";
import { expect, it } from "vitest";
import { loadDepartmentRoster } from "./loadDepartmentRoster";

it("lists the people in a department", async () => {
  const client = createMockClient();
  client
    .when((stub) =>
      stub(Employee)
        .where({ department: { $eq: "Platform" } })
        .fetchPage(),
    )
    .thenReturnObjects([
      createMockOsdkObject(Employee, { employeeId: 1, fullName: "Ada Lovelace" }),
    ]);

  expect(await loadDepartmentRoster(client, "Platform")).toEqual(["Ada Lovelace"]);
});

it("stubs function calls", async () => {
  const client = createMockClient();
  client.whenQuery(getEmployeeMetrics, { department: "Sales" }).thenReturn({ headcount: 12 });

  const result = await client(getEmployeeMetrics).executeFunction({ department: "Sales" });

  expect(result).toEqual({ headcount: 12 });
});
```

A call with no matching stub throws, with `No stub for request` for object set calls or `No stub for query '<name>'` for functions. When several stubs match, the last one registered wins.

### `@osdk/unit-testing` reference

| Export | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `createMockClient()` | A `Client` whose responses you stub. Use it with `TestOsdkProvider` or pass it to code that takes a `Client`. It does not stub actions. |
| `client.when(callback)` | Stub an object set call chain that ends in `fetchPage`, `fetchOne`, `aggregate`, or similar. Complete it with `thenReturnObjects`, `thenReturnObject`, or `thenReturnAggregation`, depending on the call. |
| `client.whenObjectSet(objectSet, callback)` | Stub calls on an object set created with `createMockObjectSet`, for code that takes an `ObjectSet` argument. |
| `client.whenQuery(fn, params?)` | Stub a function call. Complete it with `thenReturn(value)` or `thenThrow(error)`. |
| `client.clearStubs()` | Remove every stub. |
| `createMockOsdkObject(type, properties, options?)` | An object instance. See [Test a component that loads objects](#test-a-component-that-loads-objects). |
| `createMockObjectSet(type)` | A standalone object set to pass as an argument and stub with `whenObjectSet`. |
| `createMockAttachment(rid, blob?, metadata?)` | An attachment whose `fetchContents` and `fetchMetadata` return the given values. |
| `createMockWriteableClient()` | A mock client that records edits, for testing Foundry functions written with `@osdk/functions`. Read the edits with `getEdits()`. |

# foundryModel

Source: https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/aip-core/foundry-model

> Create a language model handle backed by the Foundry Language Model Service for generateText, streamText, and LmsChatTransport.

```ts
import { foundryModel } from "@osdk/aip-core";

function foundryModel(options: FoundryModelOptions): LanguageModel;
```

Returns an opaque `LanguageModel` that the other `@osdk/aip-core` functions accept. It holds the client and model identifier; it does not send a request.

## Options

### FoundryModelOptions

| Prop     | Type                        | Description                                                 |
| -------- | --------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `client` | `PlatformClient`            | Foundry PlatformClient providing the auth token + base URL. |
| `model`  | `string \| ModelIdentifier` | LMS model API name or registered model RID.                 |

`client` must be a `PlatformClient` from `createPlatformClient`. A string `model` is an LMS model API name, such as `"gpt-4o"`. To use a registered model, pass `{ type: "registeredModel", registeredModelRid }`.

## Returns

`LanguageModel`:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `modelId` | `string` | `"foundry/"` followed by the API name or RID, for logging. |
| `provider` | `string` | Always `"foundry-lms"`. |

## Example

```ts title="src/model.ts"
import { foundryModel } from "@osdk/aip-core";
import { createPlatformClient } from "@osdk/client";
import { createPublicOauthClient } from "@osdk/oauth";

const foundryUrl = "https://example.palantirfoundry.com";
const auth = createPublicOauthClient(
  "<your-client-id>",
  foundryUrl,
  "http://localhost:8080/auth/callback",
);

export const model = foundryModel({
  client: createPlatformClient(foundryUrl, auth),
  model: "gpt-4o",
});
```

## See also

- [Chat and text generation](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/ai/chat.md)

# generateText

Source: https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/aip-core/generate-text

> Generate a complete text response from a Foundry language model in one request.

```ts
import { generateText } from "@osdk/aip-core";

function generateText<TOOLS extends ToolSet = ToolSet>(
  options: GenerateTextOptions<TOOLS>,
): Promise<GenerateTextResult<TOOLS>>;
```

Sends one request to the Foundry Language Model Service and resolves when the model finishes. The call is single-step: when the model requests a tool, the result lists the call in `toolCalls`, and your code runs the tool and sends a follow-up request.

## Options

### GenerateTextOptions

Options for generateText.

| Prop                | Type                                                                                                                               | Description                                                   |
| ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `model`             | `LanguageModel`                                                                                                                    | The language model to use. Build one via `foundryModel(...)`. |
| `prompt?`           | `string \| ModelMessage[]`                                                                                                         | Plain text prompt. Mutually exclusive with `messages`.        |
| `messages?`         | `ModelMessage[]`                                                                                                                   | Conversation history. Mutually exclusive with `prompt`.       |
| `system?`           | `string \| SystemModelMessage[] \| SystemModelMessage`                                                                             | System instructions, prepended to the conversation.           |
| `tools?`            | `TOOLS`                                                                                                                            |                                                               |
| `toolChoice?`       | `ToolChoice<TOOLS>`                                                                                                                |                                                               |
| `maxOutputTokens?`  | `number`                                                                                                                           |                                                               |
| `temperature?`      | `number`                                                                                                                           |                                                               |
| `topP?`             | `number`                                                                                                                           |                                                               |
| `presencePenalty?`  | `number`                                                                                                                           |                                                               |
| `frequencyPenalty?` | `number`                                                                                                                           |                                                               |
| `stopSequences?`    | `string[]`                                                                                                                         |                                                               |
| `seed?`             | `number`                                                                                                                           |                                                               |
| `abortSignal?`      | `AbortSignal`                                                                                                                      |                                                               |
| `headers?`          | `Record<string, string \| undefined>`                                                                                              |                                                               |
| `onStepFinish?`     | `((step: StepResult<TOOLS>) => void \| Promise<void>)`                                                                             |                                                               |
| `onFinish?`         | `((event: StepResult<TOOLS> & { steps: Array<StepResult<TOOLS>>; totalUsage: LanguageModelUsage; }) => void \| PromiseLike<void>)` |                                                               |

Pass either `prompt` or `messages`, not both; passing both throws. The call also throws when `system`, `prompt`, and `messages` are all empty. Tool `inputSchema` must be a plain JSON Schema object.

## Returns

### GenerateTextResult

Result of generateText.

| Prop               | Type                                                   | Description |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------ | ----------- |
| `content`          | `ContentPart<TOOLS>[]`                                 |             |
| `text`             | `string`                                               |             |
| `reasoning`        | `ReasoningOutput[]`                                    |             |
| `reasoningText`    | `string \| undefined`                                  |             |
| `toolCalls`        | `ToolCall<keyof TOOLS & string, unknown>[]`            |             |
| `toolResults`      | `ToolResult<keyof TOOLS & string, unknown, unknown>[]` |             |
| `finishReason`     | `FinishReason`                                         |             |
| `rawFinishReason`  | `string \| undefined`                                  |             |
| `usage`            | `LanguageModelUsage`                                   |             |
| `warnings`         | `Warning[] \| undefined`                               |             |
| `request?`         | `RequestMetadata`                                      |             |
| `response?`        | `ResponseMetadata`                                     |             |
| `providerMetadata` | `ProviderMetadata \| undefined`                        |             |
| `totalUsage`       | `LanguageModelUsage`                                   |             |
| `steps`            | `StepResult<TOOLS>[]`                                  |             |

`steps` always holds one step, and `totalUsage` equals `usage`.

## Example

```ts title="src/summarize.ts"
import { foundryModel, generateText } from "@osdk/aip-core";
import type { PlatformClient } from "@osdk/client";

export async function summarize(client: PlatformClient, notes: string) {
  const { text, usage } = await generateText({
    model: foundryModel({ client, model: "gpt-4o" }),
    system: "Summarize in two sentences.",
    prompt: notes,
    maxOutputTokens: 200,
  });
  console.log(usage);
  return text;
}
```

# LmsChatTransport

Source: https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/aip-core/lms-chat-transport

> A ChatTransport that streams chat replies from the Foundry Language Model Service as UI message chunks.

```ts
import { LmsChatTransport } from "@osdk/aip-core";

class LmsChatTransport implements ChatTransport<UIMessage> {
  constructor(opts: LmsChatTransportOptions);
  sendMessages(args: ChatTransportSendMessagesArgs<UIMessage>): Promise<ReadableStream<UIMessageChunk>>;
  reconnectToStream(args: ChatTransportReconnectArgs): Promise<ReadableStream<UIMessageChunk> | null>;
}
```

Converts a `UIMessage[]` conversation to model messages, calls [`streamText`](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/aip-core/stream-text.md), and returns the reply as a stream of `UIMessageChunk`s in the AI SDK v5 UI format. Pass it to any chat UI that accepts a `ChatTransport`.

## Options

### LmsChatTransportOptions

Options for LmsChatTransport. Configures the streamed chat
completion against the Foundry Language Model Service.

| Prop                | Type                                  | Description                                                       |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `model`             | `LanguageModel`                       | Foundry-LMS-backed language model. Build via `foundryModel(...)`. |
| `system?`           | `string`                              | System prompt prepended to every request.                         |
| `temperature?`      | `number`                              | Sampling controls.                                                |
| `maxOutputTokens?`  | `number`                              |                                                                   |
| `topP?`             | `number`                              |                                                                   |
| `presencePenalty?`  | `number`                              |                                                                   |
| `frequencyPenalty?` | `number`                              |                                                                   |
| `stopSequences?`    | `string[]`                            |                                                                   |
| `seed?`             | `number`                              |                                                                   |
| `headers?`          | `Record<string, string \| undefined>` | Extra HTTP headers forwarded to LMS.                              |

`headers` passed to `sendMessages` are merged over the constructor's `headers`.

## Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sendMessages(args)` | `Promise<ReadableStream<UIMessageChunk>>` | Streams the assistant reply to `args.messages`, using `args.messageId` as its ID. Model errors arrive as an `{ type: "error", errorText }` chunk. |
| `reconnectToStream(args)` | `Promise<null>` | Always resolves to `null`; the transport cannot resume a stream. |

## Example

```ts title="src/askOnce.ts"
import { foundryModel, generateMessageId, LmsChatTransport } from "@osdk/aip-core";
import type { PlatformClient } from "@osdk/client";

export async function askOnce(client: PlatformClient, question: string) {
  const transport = new LmsChatTransport({
    model: foundryModel({ client, model: "gpt-4o" }),
    system: "Answer briefly.",
  });

  const stream = await transport.sendMessages({
    trigger: "submit-message",
    chatId: "chat-1",
    messageId: generateMessageId(),
    messages: [{ id: generateMessageId(), role: "user", parts: [{ type: "text", text: question }] }],
    abortSignal: undefined,
  });

  let answer = "";
  const reader = stream.getReader();
  while (true) {
    const { done, value } = await reader.read();
    if (done) break;
    if (value.type === "text-delta") answer += value.delta;
  }
  return answer;
}
```

- [Chat and text generation](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/ai/chat.md)
- [Utilities](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/aip-core/utilities.md)

# streamText

Source: https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/aip-core/stream-text

> Stream a text response from a Foundry language model as it is generated.

```ts
import { streamText } from "@osdk/aip-core";

function streamText<TOOLS extends ToolSet = ToolSet>(
  options: StreamTextOptions<TOOLS>,
): StreamTextResult;
```

Starts the request immediately and returns streams and promises without awaiting. Read `textStream` for text only, or `fullStream` for every chunk, including reasoning, tool calls, and the finish event. Like `generateText`, the call is single-step.

## Options

### StreamTextOptions

Options for streamText.

| Prop                | Type                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | Description                                                                      |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `model`             | `LanguageModel`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | The language model to use. Build one via `foundryModel(...)`.                    |
| `prompt?`           | `string \| ModelMessage[]`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | Plain text prompt. Mutually exclusive with `messages`.                           |
| `messages?`         | `ModelMessage[]`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Conversation history. Mutually exclusive with `prompt`.                          |
| `system?`           | `string \| SystemModelMessage[] \| SystemModelMessage`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | System instructions, prepended to the conversation.                              |
| `tools?`            | `TOOLS`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |                                                                                  |
| `toolChoice?`       | `ToolChoice<TOOLS>`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |                                                                                  |
| `maxOutputTokens?`  | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |                                                                                  |
| `temperature?`      | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |                                                                                  |
| `topP?`             | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |                                                                                  |
| `presencePenalty?`  | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |                                                                                  |
| `frequencyPenalty?` | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |                                                                                  |
| `stopSequences?`    | `string[]`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                                                  |
| `seed?`             | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |                                                                                  |
| `abortSignal?`      | `AbortSignal`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                                  |
| `headers?`          | `Record<string, string \| undefined>`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |                                                                                  |
| `onChunk?`          | `((chunk: TextStreamChunk) => void \| PromiseLike<void>)`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | Fires for every chunk emitted on `fullStream`.                                   |
| `onError?`          | `((error: Error) => void \| PromiseLike<void>)`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | Fires when the stream errors out. The same error is also emitted via the stream. |
| `onFinish?`         | `((event: { finishReason: FinishReason; text: string; reasoningText: string \| undefined; toolCalls: Array<ToolCall>; usage: LanguageModelUsage; totalUsage: LanguageModelUsage; warnings: Array<Warning> \| undefined; response: ResponseMetadata \| undefined; request: RequestMetadata \| undefined; }) => void \| PromiseLike<v...` | Fires once after the stream completes successfully.                              |

Pass either `prompt` or `messages`, not both. `streamText` throws synchronously when both are set, or when `system`, `prompt`, and `messages` are all empty. Aborting `abortSignal` or cancelling the stream stops the request.

## Returns

### StreamTextResult

Result of streamText.

`fullStream` is a `ReadableStream` (not an async iterable) so it can be
`pipeThrough`-ed with browser-native transforms.

| Prop            | Type                                     | Description                                               |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `fullStream`    | `ReadableStream<StreamChunkEvent>`       | Stream of all chunk events.                               |
| `textStream`    | `ReadableStream<string>`                 | Stream of just text-delta strings (convenience).          |
| `text`          | `Promise<string>`                        | Resolves to the final accumulated assistant text.         |
| `reasoningText` | `Promise<string \| undefined>`           | Resolves to the final accumulated reasoning text, if any. |
| `usage`         | `Promise<LanguageModelUsage>`            | Resolves to the final usage.                              |
| `totalUsage`    | `Promise<LanguageModelUsage>`            | Resolves to the same usage (single-step v0).              |
| `finishReason`  | `Promise<FinishReason>`                  | Resolves to the finish reason.                            |
| `toolCalls`     | `Promise<ToolCall<string, unknown>[]>`   | Resolves to the accumulated tool calls.                   |
| `warnings`      | `Promise<Warning[] \| undefined>`        | Resolves to v0 warnings, if any.                          |
| `response`      | `Promise<ResponseMetadata \| undefined>` | Resolves to response metadata once the stream finishes.   |
| `request`       | `Promise<RequestMetadata \| undefined>`  | Resolves to the request metadata.                         |

On failure, `fullStream` emits `{ type: "error", error }` and then errors, and the promises reject, except `warnings`, which still resolves.

### `TextStreamChunk`

| `type` | Fields |
| --- | --- |
| `"text-delta"` | `id`, `delta` |
| `"reasoning-delta"` | `id`, `delta` |
| `"tool-call"` | `toolCallId`, `toolName`, `input` |
| `"finish"` | `finishReason`, `rawFinishReason`, `usage` |
| `"error"` | `error` |

## Example

```ts title="src/streamAnswer.ts"
import { foundryModel, streamText } from "@osdk/aip-core";
import type { PlatformClient } from "@osdk/client";

export async function streamAnswer(
  client: PlatformClient,
  question: string,
  onText: (delta: string) => void,
) {
  const result = streamText({
    model: foundryModel({ client, model: "gpt-4o" }),
    prompt: question,
  });

  const reader = result.textStream.getReader();
  while (true) {
    const { done, value } = await reader.read();
    if (done) break;
    onText(value);
  }

  return result.finishReason;
}
```

# Utilities

Source: https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/aip-core/utilities

> generateMessageId and getUIMessageText, helpers for working with UIMessage conversations in @osdk/aip-core.

```ts
import { generateMessageId, getUIMessageText } from "@osdk/aip-core";

function generateMessageId(): string;
function getUIMessageText(message: UIMessage): string;
```

Helpers for building and reading the `UIMessage` objects that [`LmsChatTransport`](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/aip-core/lms-chat-transport.md) consumes.

## `generateMessageId`

Returns `crypto.randomUUID()` when available, otherwise a random `msg-` prefixed ID.

## `getUIMessageText`

Concatenates the `text` parts of `message` and ignores reasoning and file parts.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | `UIMessage` | `{ id, role, parts, metadata? }`, where `role` is `"system"`, `"user"`, or `"assistant"`. |

## Example

```ts title="src/messages.ts"
import { generateMessageId, getUIMessageText, type UIMessage } from "@osdk/aip-core";

export function userMessage(text: string): UIMessage {
  return { id: generateMessageId(), role: "user", parts: [{ type: "text", text }] };
}

export function lastReply(messages: UIMessage[]): string {
  const reply = messages.findLast((m) => m.role === "assistant");
  return reply ? getUIMessageText(reply) : "";
}
```

## See also

- [Chat and text generation](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/ai/chat.md)

# createClient

Source: https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/client/create-client

> Create the OSDK Client that queries objects, applies actions, and executes functions against one Ontology.

```ts
import { createClient } from "@osdk/client";

function createClient(
  baseUrl: string,
  ontologyRid: string | Promise<string>,
  tokenProvider: () => Promise<string>,
  options?: {
    logger?: Logger;
    UNSTABLE_DO_NOT_USE_BRANCH?: string | null;
    headers?: Record<string, string>;
  },
  fetchFn?: typeof fetch,
): Client;
```

Returns a `Client` bound to one Foundry stack and Ontology. Call the client with a definition from your generated SDK to get the matching operations, such as `client(Employee)` for an [`ObjectSet`](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/client/object-set.md).

## Parameters

The options type is inline in the source, so these tables are written by hand.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `baseUrl` | `string` | | The base URL of your Foundry stack, such as `https://example.palantirfoundry.com`. |
| `ontologyRid` | `string \| Promise<string>` | | The Ontology RID, usually `$ontologyRid` from the generated SDK. A string that does not start with `ri.` throws `Invalid ontology RID`. |
| `tokenProvider` | `() => Promise<string>` | | Returns a bearer token for each request, such as a client from `@osdk/oauth`. |
| `options` | `object` | | See below. |
| `fetchFn` | `typeof fetch` | The global `fetch` | The `fetch` implementation for every request. |

### Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `logger` | `Logger` | A minimal built-in logger | Receives the client's log output. |
| `headers` | `Record<string, string>` | | Extra headers sent with every request. |
| `UNSTABLE_DO_NOT_USE_BRANCH` | `string \| null` | Read from the page | Beta. The Foundry branch for every request. When omitted in a browser, the client reads the `foundryBranchRid` query parameter, then the branch meta tag injected by OSDK build tooling. `null` uses the default branch. |

## Returns

`Client`, a function with one call signature per definition kind, plus `fetchMetadata`.

| Call | Returns |
| --- | --- |
| `client(objectType)` or `client(interface)` | The `ObjectSet` declared by the generated SDK for that type. See [ObjectSet](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/client/object-set.md). Without a declared set, an interface gets a `MinimalObjectSet`, which has only `fetchPage`, `fetchPageWithErrors`, `asyncIter`, `where`, `subscribe`, and `experimental_asyncIterLinks`. |
| `client(action)` | `{ applyAction, batchApplyAction }`. |
| `client(query)` | `{ executeFunction }`. |
| `client.fetchMetadata(definition)` | `Promise` of `ObjectMetadata`, `InterfaceMetadata`, `ActionMetadata`, or `QueryMetadata`, matching the definition. |

## Example

```ts title="src/client.ts"
import { $ontologyRid, Employee } from "@my-app/sdk";
import { createClient } from "@osdk/client";
import { createPublicOauthClient } from "@osdk/oauth";

const foundryUrl = "https://example.palantirfoundry.com";

const auth = createPublicOauthClient(
  "<your-client-id>",
  foundryUrl,
  "http://localhost:8080/auth/callback",
);

export const client = createClient(foundryUrl, $ontologyRid, auth);

export async function firstEngineers() {
  const page = await client(Employee)
    .where({ department: "Engineering" })
    .fetchPage({ $pageSize: 10, $select: ["fullName"] });
  return page.data;
}
```

## See also

- [Create a client](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/client.md)
- [Authentication](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/authentication.md)

# createPlatformClient

Source: https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/client/create-platform-client

> Create a client for Foundry platform APIs only, without binding it to an Ontology.

```ts
import { createPlatformClient } from "@osdk/client";

function createPlatformClient(
  baseUrl: string,
  tokenProvider: () => Promise<string>,
  options?: undefined,
  fetchFn?: typeof globalThis.fetch,
): PlatformClient;
```

Returns a `PlatformClient` that you pass to functions from the `@osdk/foundry.*` packages, such as `Users.getCurrent(client)`. A `Client` from [`createClient`](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/client/create-client.md) works with platform APIs too, so you only need this when you have no Ontology to query.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `baseUrl` | `string` | | The base URL of your Foundry stack. |
| `tokenProvider` | `() => Promise<string>` | | Returns a bearer token for each request. |
| `options` | `undefined` | | Reserved. Pass `undefined`. |
| `fetchFn` | `typeof fetch` | The global `fetch` | The `fetch` implementation for every request. |

## Returns

`PlatformClient`: the base URL, token provider, and `fetch` that `@osdk/foundry.*` functions read.

## Example

```ts title="src/whoami.ts"
import { createPlatformClient } from "@osdk/client";
import { Users } from "@osdk/foundry.admin";
import { createConfidentialOauthClient } from "@osdk/oauth";

const foundryUrl = "https://example.palantirfoundry.com";
const auth = createConfidentialOauthClient(
  process.env.FOUNDRY_CLIENT_ID!,
  process.env.FOUNDRY_CLIENT_SECRET!,
  foundryUrl,
);

const platformClient = createPlatformClient(foundryUrl, auth);

const me = await Users.getCurrent(platformClient);
console.log(me.username);
```

- [Platform SDK](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/platform.md)

# Errors

Source: https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/client/errors

> PalantirApiError and ActionValidationError, the error classes thrown by @osdk/client.

```ts
import { ActionValidationError, PalantirApiError } from "@osdk/client";

class PalantirApiError extends Error {
  errorName?: string;
  errorCode?: string;
  errorDescription?: string;
  statusCode?: number;
  errorInstanceId?: string;
  parameters?: any;
}

class ActionValidationError extends Error {
  validation: ActionValidationResponse;
}
```

Requests that Foundry rejects throw `PalantirApiError`. Network failures and responses that are not JSON also throw a `PalantirApiError` subclass, with `name` set to `"UnknownError"` and no `errorCode`. Applying an action whose parameters fail validation throws `ActionValidationError` instead. Check with `instanceof`.

## `PalantirApiError`

The class has no JSDoc and inherits `Error` fields, so this table is written by hand.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | `string` | A readable summary of the error. |
| `errorName` | `string \| undefined` | The Foundry error name, such as `ObjectNotFound`. |
| `errorCode` | `string \| undefined` | The error category, such as `NOT_FOUND` or `PERMISSION_DENIED`. |
| `errorDescription` | `string \| undefined` | A longer description from the server. |
| `statusCode` | `number \| undefined` | The HTTP status code. |
| `errorInstanceId` | `string \| undefined` | An ID for this occurrence. Include it when you report an issue to Palantir support. |
| `parameters` | `any` | Error-specific details, such as the primary key that was not found. |

## `ActionValidationError`

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | `string` | `"Validation Error: "` followed by the validation response as JSON. |
| `validation.result` | `"VALID" \| "INVALID"` | The overall result. |
| `validation.submissionCriteria` | `SubmissionCriteriaEvaluation[]` | Each submission criterion and whether it passed. |
| `validation.parameters` | `Record<string, ParameterEvaluationResult>` | The evaluation of each parameter, by parameter ID. |

## Example

```ts title="src/promote.ts"
import { Employee, modifyEmployee } from "@my-app/sdk";
import { ActionValidationError, PalantirApiError, type Client } from "@osdk/client";

export async function promote(client: Client, employeeId: number) {
  try {
    const employee = await client(Employee).fetchOne(employeeId);
    await client(modifyEmployee).applyAction({ employee, jobTitle: "Lead" });
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof ActionValidationError) {
      return { ok: false, reason: e.validation.result };
    }
    if (e instanceof PalantirApiError) {
      return { ok: false, reason: `${e.errorName ?? "Error"} (${e.statusCode})` };
    }
    throw e;
  }
  return { ok: true };
}
```

## See also

- [Errors](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/sdk/errors.md)
- [useOsdkAction](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/react/use-osdk-action.md)

# ObjectSet

Source: https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/client/object-set

> Methods of an OSDK ObjectSet for filtering, set operations, pivots, aggregation, paging, and subscriptions.

```ts
import type { ObjectSet } from "@osdk/client";

interface ObjectSet<
  Q extends ObjectOrInterfaceDefinition = any,
  RDPs extends Record<string, SimplePropertyDef> = never,
> { /* methods below */ }
```

An `ObjectSet` describes a set of objects without loading them. `client(Employee)` returns the set of all employees; methods such as `where` and `pivotTo` return new sets, and methods such as `fetchPage` and `aggregate` send a request. `RDPs` holds the derived properties added with `withProperties`.

## Methods

`ObjectSet` is composed of many generic signatures that a generated table cannot render, so this table is written by hand.

### Build a set

These methods return a new set and do not send a request.

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `where(clause)` | `this` | Keeps objects that match a [`WhereClause`](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/client/where-clause.md). Chained calls combine with AND. |
| `union(...sets)` | `this` | Objects in this set or any of `sets`. |
| `intersect(...sets)` | `this` | Objects in this set and every one of `sets`. |
| `subtract(...sets)` | `this` | Objects in this set and in none of `sets`. |
| `pivotTo(linkName)` | `ObjectSet<LinkedType<Q, L>>` | The objects linked from this set through `linkName`. |
| `withProperties(definitions)` | `ObjectSet<Q, RDPs & NEW>` | Adds derived properties computed on the server. Each value is a function of a builder, such as `(base) => base.pivotTo("reports").aggregate("$count")`. |
| `nearestNeighbors(query, numNeighbors, property)` | `this` | The `numNeighbors` objects (1 to 500) closest to `query`, a string or a vector, on a vector `property`. Order by `"relevance"` to get each object's `$score`. |
| `narrowToType(type)` | `ObjectSet<T>` | Casts to an interface this type implements, or to an object type that implements this interface. Objects that do not match are dropped. |

### Load objects

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fetchPage(args?)` | `Promise<PageResult<Osdk.Instance<Q>>>` | One page of objects. Continue with `$nextPageToken`. |
| `fetchPageWithErrors(args?)` | `Promise<Result<PageResult<Osdk.Instance<Q>>>>` | Like `fetchPage`, but returns `{ value }` or `{ error }` instead of throwing. |
| `asyncIter(args?)` | `AsyncIterableIterator<Osdk.Instance<Q>>` | Every object, page by page, against a consistent snapshot. Takes the `fetchPage` arguments except `$pageSize`, `$nextPageToken`, `$snapshot`, and `$EXPERIMENTAL_defaultLoadLevel`. |
| `fetchOne(primaryKey, options?)` | `Promise<Osdk.Instance<Q>>` | One object by primary key. Throws if it does not exist. Object types only. Takes `$select`, `$includeRid`, and `$loadPropertySecurityMetadata`. |
| `fetchOneWithErrors(primaryKey, options?)` | `Promise<Result<Osdk.Instance<Q>>>` | Like `fetchOne`, but returns `{ value }` or `{ error }`. Object types only. |
| `aggregate(request)` | `Promise<AggregationsResults<Q, A>>` | Runs `$select` metrics, optionally grouped by `$groupBy`. |

`PageResult<T>` is `{ data: T[]; nextPageToken: string | undefined; totalCount: string }`.

### Watch for changes

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `subscribe(listener, options?)` | `{ unsubscribe: () => void }` | Opens a WebSocket subscription. `listener` takes `onChange`, `onSuccessfulSubscription`, `onOutOfDate`, and `onError`; `options` takes `properties` and `includeRid`. |
| `experimental_asyncIterLinks(linkNames)` | `AsyncIterableIterator<{ source, target, linkType }>` | Beta. Yields every link of the given types from objects in this set. `source` and `target` hold `$apiName` and `$primaryKey`. |

## `fetchPage` arguments

### FetchPageArgs

| Prop                                              | Type                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `$nextPageToken?`                                 | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `$pageSize?`                                      | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | The number of objects in one page. This does not limit the total number of objects: continue with `nextPageToken` to load further pages.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `$applyModifiers?`                                | `({ [P in Exclude<PropsWithMainValue<Q>, PropsWithReducers<Q>>]?: "applyMainValue" \| undefined; } & { [P in Exclude<PropsWithReducers<Q>, PropsWithMainValue<...>>]?: "applyReducers" \| undefined; } & ... & MODIFIERS & ...)` | Applies ontology-configured reducers or struct main values to properties by API name. Only properties with the corresponding configuration in the generated SDK accept a modifier: - `"applyReducers"`: reduces an array to a single element using its configured reducers. - `"applyMainValue"`: extracts a struct's configured main value. One main-value field returns that field's value; multiple fields return a struct containing only those fields. - `"applyReducersAndExtractMainValue"`: reduces a struct array, then extracts its main value. Requires both reducers and a main value. When passing `$select`, include every modified property using its plain API name, along with any other properties you need. Unlisted properties are not modified by this option. The returned property types reflect the modifiers, preserving property nullability. For an explicit `Osdk.Instance` type, use `"propertyApiName:modifier"` in its property keys. |
| `$EXPERIMENTAL_defaultLoadLevel?`                 | `DEFAULT_LOAD_LEVEL`                                                                                                                                                                                                             | Best-effort load level applied to every property without listing them: reducers and struct main values where defined, other properties unchanged. A per-property `$applyModifiers` entry wins.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `$snapshot?`                                      | `boolean`                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Ensures paging consistency by freezing the view at the time of query to prevent duplicate or missing items. Setting $snapshot to false ensures that you will always get the latest results. Without a snapshot, if objects are added, removed, or edited between requests, later pages may repeat or skip objects. A snapshot configured for a function run still applies even when this is `false`. With a snapshot, pass `$snapshot: true` on every page request; paging fails if the snapshot expires or the backend detects a paging inconsistency (`PagingInconsistencyDetected`). Stream-backed object types do not provide this snapshot guarantee across pages. `asyncIter()` always requests a snapshot. Default: `false`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `$orderBy?`                                       | `ORDER_BY_OPTIONS`                                                                                                                                                                                                               |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `$select?`                                        | `readonly K[]`                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | The properties to load for each object. If omitted, the API loads its default property set (vector properties, for example, are not included). The primary key is always returned, even when it is not selected. Select only the properties your code needs. Loading unused properties wastes bandwidth and compute and can slow down retrieval, and reading fewer properties afterwards does not avoid the cost of fetching them. Ontology-defined derived properties are not returned by default and must be included in `$select`. Include any other properties you need in the same selection. Runtime-defined derived properties added via `.withProperties(...)` are returned by default only when `$select` is omitted. If you pass `$select`, include them in the selection as well.                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `$includeRid?`                                    | `R`                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `$loadPropertySecurityMetadata?`                  | `PROPERTY_SECURITIES`                                                                                                                                                                                                            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `$UNSTABLE_loadOntologyDefinedDerivedProperties?` | `boolean`                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `$includeAllBaseObjectProperties?`                | `(PropertyKeys<Q> extends K ? T : never)`                                                                                                                                                                                        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

`$orderBy` takes `{ [property]: "asc" | "desc" }`, or `"relevance"` after `nearestNeighbors`. `$includeRid: true` adds `$rid` to each object. `$includeAllBaseObjectProperties: true` loads every property of the underlying object type for interface sets.

## Example

```ts title="src/topEarners.ts"
import { Employee } from "@my-app/sdk";
import type { Client } from "@osdk/client";

export async function topEarners(client: Client, city: string) {
  const inCity = client(Employee)
    .where({ salary: { $gt: 100_000 } })
    .intersect(client(Employee).pivotTo("office").where({ city }).pivotTo("occupants"));

  const page = await inCity.fetchPage({
    $select: ["fullName", "salary"],
    $orderBy: { salary: "desc" },
    $pageSize: 20,
  });

  return page.data.map((e) => `${e.fullName}: ${e.salary}`);
}
```
