# Osdk.Instance

Source: https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/client/osdk-instance

> The type of a loaded object, with its properties plus $-prefixed fields for identity, links, and conversion.

```ts
import type { Osdk } from "@osdk/client";

namespace Osdk {
  type Instance<
    Q extends ObjectOrInterfaceDefinition,
    OPTIONS extends never | "$rid" | "$allBaseProperties" | "$propertySecurities" = never,
    P extends PropertyKeys<Q> = PropertyKeys<Q>,
    R extends Record<string, SimplePropertyDef> = {},
  >;
}
```

Every object returned by `fetchPage`, `fetchOne`, `asyncIter`, and the `@osdk/react` hooks has this type. It holds the properties in `P`, the derived properties in `R`, and the fields below. Generated SDKs export a shorthand, such as `Employee.OsdkInstance`.

| Type parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Q` | The object type or interface. |
| `OPTIONS` | Extra fields: `"$rid"` adds `$rid`, `"$propertySecurities"` adds `$propertySecurities`, and `"$allBaseProperties"` marks an interface instance that carries every property of its object type. |
| `P` | The loaded properties. Narrowed by `$select`. |
| `R` | Derived properties added with `withProperties`. |

## Fields

`Osdk.Instance` is an intersection of mapped and conditional types, so this table is written by hand.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `$apiName` | `Q["apiName"]` | The API name of `Q`. For an interface instance, the interface name. |
| `$objectType` | `string` | The API name of the underlying object type, also for interface instances. |
| `$primaryKey` | `PrimaryKeyType<Q>` | The primary key value. |
| `$title` | `string \| undefined` | The value of the type's title property. |
| `$objectSpecifier` | `ObjectSpecifier<Q>` | A string that identifies the object across object types. |
| `$link` | `{ [link]: SingleLinkAccessor \| ObjectSet }` | Links of the object. A single link has `fetchOne` and `fetchOneWithErrors`; a many link is an [`ObjectSet`](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/client/object-set.md). |
| `$as` | `(type) => Osdk.Instance` | Converts between an object type and an interface it implements, mapping property names. |
| `$clone` | `(updates?) => Osdk.Instance` | Returns a copy with some properties replaced. Use it to build optimistic updates. |
| `$rid` | `string` | The object's RID. Present only when loaded with `$includeRid: true`. |
| `$propertySecurities` | `ObjectPropertySecurities` | Per-property marking requirements. Present only when loaded with `$loadPropertySecurityMetadata: true`. |
| `$score` | `number` | Relevance score. Present only when ordered by `"relevance"`. |

## Example

```ts title="src/describeEmployee.ts"
import { Employee, Worker } from "@my-app/sdk";
import type { Client, Osdk } from "@osdk/client";

export async function describeEmployee(client: Client, employeeId: number) {
  const employee: Osdk.Instance<Employee> = await client(Employee).fetchOne(employeeId);

  const lead = await employee.$link.lead.fetchOne();
  const reports = await employee.$link.reports.fetchPage({ $pageSize: 5 });
  const asWorker = employee.$as(Worker);

  return {
    key: `${employee.$objectType}:${employee.$primaryKey}`,
    title: employee.$title,
    lead: lead.fullName,
    reports: reports.data.map((r) => r.fullName),
    workerName: asWorker.name,
  };
}
```

- [Load objects](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/sdk/objects.md)
- [Interfaces](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/sdk/interfaces.md)

# WhereClause

Source: https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/client/where-clause

> Filter operators accepted by ObjectSet.where and the where option of @osdk/react hooks, by property type.

```ts
import type { WhereClause } from "@osdk/client";

type WhereClause<
  T extends ObjectOrInterfaceDefinition,
  RDPs extends Record<string, SimplePropertyDef> = {},
> =
  | { $and: WhereClause<T, RDPs>[] }
  | { $or: WhereClause<T, RDPs>[] }
  | { $not: WhereClause<T, RDPs> }
  | { $title?: Filter; $primaryKey?: Filter }
  | { [property in PropertyKeys<T>]?: FilterFor<property> };
```

A where clause maps property names to filters. Properties in one clause combine with AND. A bare value, such as `{ department: "Engineering" }`, is shorthand for `$eq`. Each filter object holds exactly one operator.

The type is a union of mapped and conditional types, so these tables are written by hand.

## Logical operators

| Operator | Value | Matches |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `$and` | `WhereClause[]` | Objects that match every clause. |
| `$or` | `WhereClause[]` | Objects that match at least one clause. |
| `$not` | `WhereClause` | Objects that do not match the clause. |

## Operators by property type

| Operator | string | number | date and timestamp | boolean | Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$eq`, `$ne` | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | A value of the property's type. |
| `$in` | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | An array of values. An empty array matches every object. |
| `$isNull` | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | `true` or `false`. |
| `$gt`, `$gte`, `$lt`, `$lte` | Yes | Yes | Yes | | A bound. Dates and timestamps take ISO 8601 strings. |
| `$startsWith` | Yes | | | | A prefix, or `{ term, phoneticSearch? }`. |
| `$containsAnyTerm` | Yes | | | | A string, `{ term, fuzzySearch? }`, or `{ term, phoneticSearch? }`. Matches any whitespace-separated term. |
| `$containsAllTerms` | Yes | | | | A string, `{ term, fuzzySearch? }`, or `{ term, phoneticSearch? }`. Matches every term, in any order. |
| `$containsAllTermsInOrder` | Yes | | | | A string, or `{ term, phoneticSearch? }`. Matches the terms in order. |
| `$interval` | Yes | | | | An `IntervalRule`. |
| `$matchesRegex` | Yes | | | | Beta. A regular expression in Foundry search syntax. |

Number filters apply to `integer`, `long`, `double`, `float`, `decimal`, and `byte` properties.

### Array properties

| Operator | Value | Matches |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `$contains` | An element value | Arrays that contain the value. |
| `$isNull` | `boolean` | Arrays that are null, or not null. |

### Geo properties

`geopoint` and `geoshape` properties take `$within`, `$intersects`, and `$isNull`.

| Operator | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `$within` | `{ $distance: [number, unit], $of: [lon, lat] \| Point }`, `{ $bbox: BBox }`, a `BBox`, `{ $polygon: coordinates }`, or a GeoJSON `Polygon`. |
| `$intersects` | `{ $bbox: BBox }`, a `BBox`, `{ $polygon: coordinates }`, or a GeoJSON `Polygon`. |

The distance unit is one of `"cm"`, `"m"`, `"km"`, `"inches"`, `"feet"`, `"yards"`, `"miles"`, or `"nautical miles"`, or a singular or long form such as `"meter"` or `"kilometers"`.

### Struct properties

Filter one field of a struct property by nesting it: `{ address: { city: { $eq: "Denver" } } }`. A struct filter holds exactly one field.

## Example

```ts title="src/seniorEngineers.ts"
import { Employee } from "@my-app/sdk";
import type { Client, WhereClause } from "@osdk/client";

const seniorEngineers: WhereClause<Employee> = {
  $and: [
    { department: "Engineering" },
    { startDate: { $lt: "2020-01-01" } },
    { $or: [{ jobTitle: { $startsWith: "Senior" } }, { skills: { $contains: "Go" } }] },
    { $not: { salary: { $isNull: true } } },
  ],
};

export function loadSeniorEngineers(client: Client) {
  return client(Employee).where(seniorEngineers).fetchPage({ $pageSize: 50 });
}
```

## See also

- [Filtering](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/sdk/filtering.md)

# createAuthlessClient

Source: https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/oauth/create-authless-client

> Create a token provider that always returns the public token, for Foundry resources that need no sign-in.

```ts
import { createAuthlessClient } from "@osdk/oauth";

function createAuthlessClient(): () => Promise<string>;
```

Returns a token provider that resolves to the string `"PUBLIC"` on every call. Pass it to `createClient` when your app reads resources that Foundry serves without authentication.

## Returns

`() => Promise<string>`: resolves to `"PUBLIC"`.

## Example

```ts title="src/client.ts"
import { $ontologyRid } from "@my-app/sdk";
import { createClient } from "@osdk/client";
import { createAuthlessClient } from "@osdk/oauth";

export const client = createClient(
  "https://example.palantirfoundry.com",
  $ontologyRid,
  createAuthlessClient(),
);
```

- [Authentication](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/authentication.md)

# createConfidentialOauthClient

Source: https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/oauth/create-confidential-oauth-client

> Create a server-side token provider that authenticates with a client ID and secret using the client credentials grant.

```ts
import { createConfidentialOauthClient } from "@osdk/oauth";

function createConfidentialOauthClient(
  client_id: string,
  client_secret: string,
  url: string,
  scopes?: string[],
  fetchFn?: typeof globalThis.fetch,
  ctxPath?: string,
): ConfidentialOauthClient;
```

Returns a function you pass as the `tokenProvider` of `createClient` or `createPlatformClient`. It requests a token on the first call and requests a new one after the current token expires. Use it only on a server or in a script, where the secret stays private.

## Parameters

The parameters are positional and have no options type, so this table is written by hand.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `client_id` | `string` | | The client ID of your Developer Console application. |
| `client_secret` | `string` | | The client secret of the application. |
| `url` | `string` | | The base URL of your Foundry stack. |
| `scopes` | `string[]` | `["api:read-data", "api:write-data", "api:use-ontologies-read", "api:use-ontologies-write"]` | The OAuth scopes to request. |
| `fetchFn` | `typeof fetch` | `globalThis.fetch` | The `fetch` implementation for token requests. |
| `ctxPath` | `string` | `"multipass"` | The context path of the authorization server. |

## Returns

`ConfidentialOauthClient`:

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `()` | `() => Promise<string>` | Returns a valid access token, requesting a new one if needed. |
| `getTokenOrUndefined` | `() => string \| undefined` | The current access token, or `undefined` if there is none or it expired. |
| `signIn` | `() => Promise<Token>` | Requests a new token. |
| `signOut` | `() => Promise<void>` | Revokes the access token. Throws when there is no token. |
| `addEventListener` | `(type, listener, options?) => void` | Listens for `"signIn"` or `"signOut"`. |
| `removeEventListener` | `(type, listener, options?) => void` | Removes a listener. |

## Example

```ts title="scripts/countEmployees.ts"
import { $ontologyRid, Employee } from "@my-app/sdk";
import { createClient } from "@osdk/client";
import { createConfidentialOauthClient } from "@osdk/oauth";

const foundryUrl = "https://example.palantirfoundry.com";

const auth = createConfidentialOauthClient(
  process.env.FOUNDRY_CLIENT_ID!,
  process.env.FOUNDRY_CLIENT_SECRET!,
  foundryUrl,
  ["api:use-ontologies-read", "api:read-data"],
);

const client = createClient(foundryUrl, $ontologyRid, auth);

const { $count } = await client(Employee).aggregate({ $select: { $count: "unordered" } });
console.log(`${$count} employees`);
```

- [Node.js](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/frameworks/node.md)

# createPublicOauthClient

Source: https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/oauth/create-public-oauth-client

> Create a browser token provider that signs users in with the OAuth authorization code flow and PKCE.

```ts
import { createPublicOauthClient } from "@osdk/oauth";

function createPublicOauthClient(
  clientId: string,
  url: string,
  redirectUrl: string,
  options?: PublicOauthClientOptions,
): PublicOauthClient;
```

Returns a function you pass as the `tokenProvider` of `createClient`. The first call without a stored token redirects the browser to Foundry to sign in. After the redirect back to `redirectUrl`, the client exchanges the code, stores the refresh token per `tokenStorage`, and refreshes the access token one minute before it expires.

An older overload takes `useHistory`, `loginPage`, `postLoginPage`, `scopes`, `fetchFn`, and `ctxPath` as positional arguments. Prefer `options`, which also accepts `refreshTokenMarker`, `tokenStorage`, and `logger`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `clientId` | `string` | The client ID of your Developer Console application. |
| `url` | `string` | The base URL of your Foundry stack. |
| `redirectUrl` | `string` | The redirect URL registered on the application. It must be a route of your app. |
| `options` | `PublicOauthClientOptions` | See below. |

## Options

### PublicOauthClientOptions

| Prop                  | Type                                                                     | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `useHistory?`         | `boolean`                                                                | If true, uses `history.replaceState()`, otherwise uses `window.location.assign()` (defaults to true)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `loginPage?`          | `string`                                                                 | Custom landing page URL prior to logging in                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `postLoginPage?`      | `string`                                                                 | URL to return to after completed authentication cycle (defaults to `window.location.toString()`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `scopes?`             | `string[]`                                                               | OAuth scopes to request. Defaults to `["api:read-data", "api:write-data", "api:use-ontologies-read", "api:use-ontologies-write"]`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `fetchFn?`            | `((input: RequestInfo \| URL, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>)` | Custom fetch function to use for requests (defaults to `globalThis.fetch`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `ctxPath?`            | `string`                                                                 | Context path for the authorization server (defaults to "multipass")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `refreshTokenMarker?` | `string`                                                                 | Allows for an additional value to be appended to the local storage key for the refresh token.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `tokenStorage?`       | `TokenStorageType`                                                       | Controls how refresh tokens are stored. Affects security vs. convenience tradeoff. - `'localStorage'` (default): Tokens persist across browser sessions. Best UX but vulnerable on shared devices. - `'sessionStorage'`: Tokens cleared when browser/tab closes. Recommended for shared devices. Users re-authenticate each browser session. - `'none'`: Tokens never stored. Users re-authenticate on every page load. Most secure but worst UX. Does not request `offline_access` scope. Default: `'localStorage'` |
| `logger?`             | `OauthLogger`                                                            | Optional logger for warning messages. If not provided, warnings are silently dropped. Structurally compatible with `@osdk/api`'s `Logger`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

When `scopes` is omitted, the client requests `api:read-data`, `api:write-data`, `api:use-ontologies-read`, and `api:use-ontologies-write`. Unless `tokenStorage` is `"none"`, it also requests `offline_access` to get a refresh token.

## Returns

`PublicOauthClient`. The interface has no JSDoc, so this table is written by hand.

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `()` | `() => Promise<string>` | Returns a valid access token, signing in or refreshing first if needed. |
| `getTokenOrUndefined` | `() => string \| undefined` | The current access token without signing in, or `undefined`. |
| `signIn` | `() => Promise<Token>` | Signs in: uses the stored refresh token, completes a pending redirect, or redirects to Foundry. Concurrent calls share one attempt. |
| `signOut` | `() => Promise<void>` | Revokes the access token and removes the stored refresh token. Throws when not signed in. |
| `refresh` | `() => Promise<Token \| undefined>` | Refreshes the access token with the stored refresh token. Throws when none is stored or the refresh fails. |
| `addEventListener` | `(type, listener, options?) => void` | Listens for `"signIn"`, `"signOut"`, or `"refresh"`. `signIn` and `refresh` events carry the `Token` in `detail`. |
| `removeEventListener` | `(type, listener, options?) => void` | Removes a listener. |

`Token` is `{ access_token: string; expires_in: number; refresh_token?: string; expires_at: number }`.

## Example

```ts title="src/auth.ts"
import { createPublicOauthClient } from "@osdk/oauth";

export const auth = createPublicOauthClient(
  "<your-client-id>",
  "https://example.palantirfoundry.com",
  "http://localhost:8080/auth/callback",
  {
    scopes: ["api:use-ontologies-read", "api:use-ontologies-write"],
    tokenStorage: "sessionStorage",
  },
);

auth.addEventListener("signOut", () => {
  window.location.assign("/");
});
```

- [Authentication](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/authentication.md)
- [createClient](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/client/create-client.md)

# OsdkProvider

Source: https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/react/osdk-provider

> React context provider that shares an OSDK client and its normalized cache with every hook below it.

```ts
import { OsdkProvider } from "@osdk/react";

function OsdkProvider(props: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  client: Client;
  enableDevTools?: boolean;
  devMode?: ObservableClientOptions["devMode"];
}): React.JSX.Element;
```

Wraps your app so `@osdk/react` hooks can reach the client. The provider builds an `ObservableClient` from `client`, which holds the shared cache, and rebuilds it whenever `client` changes.

## Props

The props type is not exported, so this table is written by hand.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `client` | `Client` | | The client from `createClient` in `@osdk/client`. Create it once at module scope; a new instance starts a new, empty cache. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | | The tree that uses OSDK hooks. |
| `enableDevTools` | `boolean` | `true` when devtools are registered | Turns the devtools integration on or off. Ignored in production builds. |
| `devMode` | `ObservableClientOptions["devMode"]` | | Development-only behavior of the observable client. Ignored in production builds. See the fields below. |

### `devMode` fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `actionDelayMs` | `number` | Delay, in milliseconds, applied to the result of an action that has an optimistic update, so the optimistic state stays visible. Defaults to `1000`; pass `0` to disable it. |
| `logLevel` | `"trace" \| "debug" \| "info" \| "warn" \| "error" \| "fatal"` | Log level of the observable client. Defaults to `"error"`; pass `"debug"` to see its tracing. |
| `debug.refCounts` | `boolean` | Logs the reference-count lifecycle of cache entries and shortens their retention window. |
| `debug.cacheKeys` | `boolean` | Logs cache-key lookups. |

## Example

```tsx title="src/Root.tsx"
import { $ontologyRid } from "@my-app/sdk";
import { createClient } from "@osdk/client";
import { createPublicOauthClient } from "@osdk/oauth";
import { OsdkProvider } from "@osdk/react";

const foundryUrl = "https://example.palantirfoundry.com";
const auth = createPublicOauthClient(
  "<your-client-id>",
  foundryUrl,
  "http://localhost:8080/auth/callback",
);
const client = createClient(foundryUrl, $ontologyRid, auth);

function App() {
  return <main>My app</main>;
}

export function Root() {
  return (
    <OsdkProvider client={client}>
      <App />
    </OsdkProvider>
  );
}
```

- [Create a client](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/client.md)
- [Devtools](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/devtools.md)

# @osdk/react/platform-apis

Source: https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/react/platform-apis

> Hooks for Foundry users, markings, and CBAC banners and restrictions, built on @osdk/foundry.admin.

These hooks call Foundry platform APIs with the client from `OsdkProvider`. Install the optional peer dependencies first:

```npm
npm install @osdk/foundry.admin @osdk/foundry.core
```

All hooks share these behaviors:

- Each hook instance fetches on mount and keeps its result in component state. Results are not shared through the OSDK cache, so two components that call the same hook make two requests.
- `isLoading` is `true` while enabled and no response has arrived. When `enabled` is `false`, the hook does not fetch and `isLoading` is `false`.
- `refetch()` reruns the request. The data field is `undefined` until the new response arrives.
- `error` holds the request error, if any.

## useCurrentFoundryUser

```ts
function useCurrentFoundryUser(
  options?: UseCurrentFoundryUserOptions,
): UseCurrentFoundryUserResult;
```

Gets the signed-in user.

### UseCurrentFoundryUserOptions

| Prop       | Type      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ---------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `enabled?` | `boolean` | Enable or disable the query. When `false`, the query will not automatically execute. This is useful for: - Lazy/on-demand queries that should wait for user interaction - Dependent queries that need data from another query first - Conditional queries based on component state Default: `true });` |

Returns `{ currentUser, isLoading, error, refetch }`, where `currentUser` is a `User` from `@osdk/foundry.admin`.

## useFoundryUser

```ts
function useFoundryUser(
  userId: string,
  options?: UseFoundryUserOptions,
): UseFoundryUserResult;
```

Gets one user by ID.

### UseFoundryUserOptions

| Prop       | Type         | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ---------- | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `enabled?` | `boolean`    | Enable or disable the query. When `false`, the query will not automatically execute. This is useful for: - Lazy/on-demand queries that should wait for user interaction - Dependent queries that need data from another query first - Conditional queries based on component state Default: `true });` |
| `status?`  | `UserStatus` | The default status of the users returned in the list. Default: `"ACTIVE"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

Returns `{ user, isLoading, error, refetch }`, where `user` is a `User`.

## useFoundryUsersList

```ts
function useFoundryUsersList(
  options?: UseFoundryUsersListOptions,
): UseFoundryUsersListResult;
```

Lists users one page at a time. A page can hold more or fewer users than `pageSize`.

### UseFoundryUsersListOptions

| Prop         | Type         | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ------------ | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `enabled?`   | `boolean`    | Enable or disable the query. When `false`, the query will not automatically execute. This is useful for: - Lazy/on-demand queries that should wait for user interaction - Dependent queries that need data from another query first - Conditional queries based on component state Default: `true });` |
| `include?`   | `UserStatus` | The default status of the users returned in the list. Default: `"ACTIVE"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `pageSize?`  | `number`     | The preferred page size for the list. Default: `1000`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `pageToken?` | `string`     | The page token indicates where to start paging. This should be omitted from the first page's request. To fetch the next page, clients should take the value from the nextPageToken field of the previous response and use it to populate the pageToken field of the next request.                      |

Returns `{ users, nextPageToken, isLoading, error, refetch }`. Pass `nextPageToken` as `pageToken` to load the next page; it is `undefined` on the last page.

# @osdk/react/testing

Source: https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/react/testing

> TestOsdkProvider and fakeObservableClient for rendering @osdk/react components in unit tests.

```ts
import { fakeObservableClient, TestOsdkProvider } from "@osdk/react/testing";

function TestOsdkProvider(props: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  client: Client;
  observableClient: ObservableClient;
}): React.JSX.Element;

const fakeObservableClient: ObservableClient;
```

`TestOsdkProvider` puts a `client` and an `observableClient` of your choice into context, skipping the devtools and user-agent setup of `OsdkProvider`. Use it only in tests; in production, `OsdkProvider` derives the observable client from `client` so the two cannot diverge.

## `TestOsdkProvider` props

The props type is inline in the source, so this table is written by hand.

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `client` | `Client` | Returned by `useOsdkClient` and used by the platform API hooks. |
| `observableClient` | `ObservableClient` | Used by the data hooks such as `useOsdkObjects` and returned by `useObservableClient`. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | The tree under test. |

## `fakeObservableClient`

An `ObservableClient` whose every method throws. Pass it when the code under test never uses the observable client, so an unexpected call fails the test instead of returning `undefined`.

## Example

```tsx title="src/ClientStatus.test.tsx"
import { createMockClient } from "@osdk/unit-testing";
import { useOsdkClient } from "@osdk/react";
import { fakeObservableClient, TestOsdkProvider } from "@osdk/react/testing";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { expect, it } from "vitest";

const mockClient = createMockClient();

function ClientStatus() {
  const client = useOsdkClient();
  return <p>{client === mockClient ? "mock client" : "other client"}</p>;
}

it("reads the client from context", () => {
  render(
    <TestOsdkProvider client={mockClient} observableClient={fakeObservableClient}>
      <ClientStatus />
    </TestOsdkProvider>,
  );
  expect(screen.getByText("mock client")).toBeDefined();
});
```

# useDebouncedCallback

Source: https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/react/use-debounced-callback

> Debounce a callback, such as an action call from a text input, with cancel and flush controls.

```ts
import { useDebouncedCallback } from "@osdk/react";

function useDebouncedCallback<TArgs extends readonly unknown[]>(
  callback: (...args: TArgs) => void | Promise<void>,
  delay: number,
): DebouncedCallback<TArgs>;
```

Returns a function that calls `callback` once `delay` milliseconds pass without another call. The latest `callback` is always used, and a pending call is cancelled when the component unmounts.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `callback` | `(...args: TArgs) => void \| Promise<void>` | The function to debounce. A returned promise is not awaited, so handle its errors inside `callback`. |
| `delay` | `number` | Milliseconds to wait after the last call. |

## Returns

`DebouncedCallback<TArgs>`, a function with the same arguments as `callback` and two methods:

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `(...args)` | `(...args: TArgs) => void` | Schedules `callback` with these arguments and cancels any pending call. |
| `cancel` | `() => void` | Drops the pending call. |
| `flush` | `() => void` | Runs the pending call immediately. |

## Example

```tsx title="src/JobTitleInput.tsx"
import { Employee, modifyEmployee } from "@my-app/sdk";
import { useDebouncedCallback, useOsdkAction } from "@osdk/react";

export function JobTitleInput({ employee }: { employee: Employee.OsdkInstance }) {
  const { applyAction, error } = useOsdkAction(modifyEmployee);

  const save = useDebouncedCallback(async (jobTitle: string) => {
    try {
      await applyAction({ employee, jobTitle });
    } catch {
      // The hook result exposes the failure as error.
    }
  }, 500);

  return (
    <>
      <input
        defaultValue={employee.jobTitle}
        onChange={(e) => save(e.target.value)}
      />
      {error && <p role="alert">Could not save.</p>}
    </>
  );
}
```

## See also

- [Actions](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/react/actions.md)

# useLinks

Source: https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/react/use-links

> Load the objects linked from one or more source objects through a named link.

```ts
import { useLinks } from "@osdk/react";

function useLinks<T extends ObjectOrInterfaceDefinition, L extends LinkNames<T>>(
  objects: Osdk.Instance<T> | Array<Osdk.Instance<T>> | undefined,
  linkName: L,
  options?: UseLinksOptions<LinkedType<T, L>>,
): UseLinksResult<LinkedType<T, L>>;
```

Follows `linkName` from each source object and returns the linked objects as one list. Pass `undefined` while the source object is still loading; until it arrives, the hook returns `links: []` with `isLoading: false`.

## Options

### UseLinksOptions

| Prop                               | Type                                                         | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `where?`                           | `WhereClause<T>`                                             | Standard OSDK Where clause for filtering linked objects                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `pageSize?`                        | `number`                                                     | The preferred page size for the links list.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `orderBy?`                         | `{ [K in PropertyKeys<T>]?: "asc" \| "desc" \| undefined; }` | Sorting options for the linked objects                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `$select?`                         | `readonly PropertyKeys<T>[]`                                 | Restrict which properties are returned for each linked object. When provided, only the specified properties will be fetched, reducing payload sizes for list views.                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `mode?`                            | `"force" \| "offline"`                                       | The mode to use for fetching data. - undefined: Fetch data if not already in cache - "force": Always fetch fresh data - "offline": Only use cached data, don't make network requests                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `dedupeIntervalMs?`                | `number`                                                     | The number of milliseconds to wait after the last observed link change. Two uses of `useLinks` with the same parameters will only trigger one network request if the second is within `dedupeIntervalMs`.                                                                                                                                               |
| `enabled?`                         | `boolean`                                                    | Enable or disable the query. When `false`, the query does not run and the hook returns no data, even if the cache already holds a result. This is useful for: - Lazy/on-demand queries that should wait for user interaction - Dependent queries that need data from another query first - Conditional queries based on component state Default: `true` |
| `$includeAllBaseObjectProperties?` | `boolean`                                                    | When true, includes all properties of the underlying concrete object type for interface link targets. Has no effect when the link target is a plain object type.                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `resolveToObjectType?`             | `boolean`                                                    |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

## Returns

### UseLinksResult

| Prop                              | Type                                                                                                    | Description                                                                                                                                                                      |
| --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `links`                           | `Osdk.Instance<Q, "$allBaseProperties", PropertyKeys<Q>, {}>[] \| undefined`                            |                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `linkedObjectsBySourcePrimaryKey` | `ReadonlyMap<string \| number, readonly Osdk.Instance<Q, "$allBaseProperties", PropertyKeys<Q>, {}>[]>` | Maps each source object's primary key to its linked object instances. Useful when observing links from multiple source objects to determine which source links to which targets. |
| `isLoading`                       | `boolean`                                                                                               |                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `error`                           | `Error \| undefined`                                                                                    |                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `isOptimistic`                    | `boolean`                                                                                               | Refers to whether the links are optimistic or not.                                                                                                                               |
| `fetchMore`                       | `(() => Promise<unknown>) \| undefined`                                                                 | Fetch more linked objects if pagination is supported                                                                                                                             |
| `hasMore`                         | `boolean`                                                                                               | Indicates if there are more linked objects available to fetch                                                                                                                    |

## Example

```tsx title="src/DirectReports.tsx"
import { Employee } from "@my-app/sdk";
import { useLinks, useOsdkObject } from "@osdk/react";

export function DirectReports({ employeeId }: { employeeId: number }) {
  const { object: employee } = useOsdkObject(Employee, employeeId);
  const { links: reports, isLoading, error } = useLinks(employee, "reports", {
    orderBy: { fullName: "asc" },
  });

  return (
    <section aria-busy={isLoading}>
      {error && <p role="alert">{error.message}</p>}
      <ul>
        {reports?.map((report) => (
          <li key={report.$primaryKey}>{report.fullName}</li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## See also

- [Load linked objects](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/react/links.md)

# useObjectSet

Source: https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/react/use-object-set

> Load a live, paged list from an ObjectSet, with filters, set operations, pivots, and derived properties applied on top.

```ts
import { useObjectSet } from "@osdk/react";

function useObjectSet<
  Q extends ObjectOrInterfaceDefinition,
  BaseRDPs extends Record<string, SimplePropertyDef> = never,
  RDPs extends Record<string, SimplePropertyDef> = {},
>(
  baseObjectSet: ObjectSet<Q, BaseRDPs> | undefined,
  options?: UseObjectSetOptions<Q, RDPs>,
): UseObjectSetResult<Q, RDPs>;
```

Starts from an `ObjectSet` you build with the client and applies `options` before fetching. Pass `undefined` to wait; the hook does not fetch until it has a set. The hook keys the query on the set's wire definition, so a new `ObjectSet` instance with the same definition does not refetch.

## Options

### UseObjectSetOptions

| Prop                | Type                                                          | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `where?`            | `WhereClause<Q, RDPs>`                                        | Where clause for filtering                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `withProperties?`   | `{ [K in keyof RDPs]: DerivedProperty.Creator<Q, RDPs[K]>; }` | Derived properties to add to the object set                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `union?`            | `ObjectSet<Q, never>[]`                                       | Object sets to union with                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `intersect?`        | `ObjectSet<Q, never>[]`                                       | Object sets to intersect with                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `subtract?`         | `ObjectSet<Q, never>[]`                                       | Object sets to subtract from                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `pivotTo?`          | `LinkNames<Q>`                                                | Link to pivot to (changes the type). Cannot be combined with `streamUpdates`. The server does not support websocket subscriptions for link-traversal queries.                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `pageSize?`         | `number`                                                      | The preferred page size for the list                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `orderBy?`          | `{ [K in PropertyKeys<Q>]?: "asc" \| "desc" \| undefined; }`  | Sort order for the results                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `dedupeIntervalMs?` | `number`                                                      | Minimum time between fetch requests in milliseconds (defaults to 2000ms)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `autoFetchMore?`    | `number \| boolean`                                           | Automatically fetch additional pages on initial load. - `true`: Fetch all available pages automatically - `number`: Fetch pages until at least this many items are loaded - `undefined` (default): Only fetch the first page, user must call fetchMore()                                                                                                |
| `streamUpdates?`    | `boolean`                                                     | Enable streaming updates via websocket subscription. When true, the object set will automatically update when matching objects are added, updated, or removed. Cannot be combined with `pivotTo`. The server does not support websocket subscriptions for link-traversal queries. Default: `false`                                                      |
| `$select?`          | `readonly PropertyKeys<Q>[]`                                  | Restrict which properties are returned for each object. When provided, only the specified properties will be fetched, reducing payload sizes for list views.                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `enabled?`          | `boolean`                                                     | Enable or disable the query. When `false`, the query does not run and the hook returns no data, even if the cache already holds a result. This is useful for: - Lazy/on-demand queries that should wait for user interaction - Dependent queries that need data from another query first - Conditional queries based on component state Default: `true` |

## Returns

### UseObjectSetResult

| Prop           | Type                                                                           | Description                                                               |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `data`         | `Osdk.Instance<Q, "$allBaseProperties", PropertyKeys<Q>, RDPs>[] \| undefined` | The fetched data with derived properties                                  |
| `isLoading`    | `boolean`                                                                      | Whether data is currently being loaded                                    |
| `error`        | `Error \| undefined`                                                           | Any error that occurred during fetching                                   |
| `isOptimistic` | `boolean`                                                                      |                                                                           |
| `fetchMore`    | `(() => Promise<void>) \| undefined`                                           | Function to fetch more pages (undefined if no more pages)                 |
| `hasMore`      | `boolean`                                                                      |                                                                           |
| `objectSet`    | `ObjectSet<Q, RDPs> \| undefined`                                              | The final ObjectSet after all transformations                             |
| `totalCount?`  | `string`                                                                       | The total count of objects matching the query (if available from the API) |
| `refetch`      | `() => Promise<void>`                                                          |                                                                           |

While a new query loads, `data` keeps the last completed result for the same object type, so the list does not flash empty between filters.

## Example

```tsx title="src/OfficeOccupants.tsx"
import { Office } from "@my-app/sdk";
import { useObjectSet, useOsdkClient } from "@osdk/react";
import { useMemo } from "react";

export function OfficeOccupants({ city }: { city: string }) {
  const client = useOsdkClient();
  const occupants = useMemo(
    () => client(Office).where({ city }).pivotTo("occupants"),
    [client, city],
  );
  const { data, isLoading, error } = useObjectSet(occupants, {
    orderBy: { fullName: "asc" },
  });

  return (
    <section aria-busy={isLoading}>
      {error && <p role="alert">{error.message}</p>}
      <ul>
        {data?.map((employee) => (
          <li key={employee.$primaryKey}>{employee.fullName}</li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </section>
  );
}
```
